title: Standard iGEM Cell Measurement Protocol
author: Richard Tennant
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zgmf3u6
materials: You have now completed this calibration protocol

steps.title: Transform Escherichia coli DH5α
steps.instruction: Transform Escherichia coli DH5α with the plasmids (all in pSB1C3) following the iGEM protocols for competent cell creation, competency measurement, DNA resuspension, and transformation.

steps.title: Inoculate and Grow Cultures
steps.instruction: Pick 2 colonies from each transformation plate and inoculate them in 5-10 mL LB medium supplemented with Chloramphenicol (25 mg/ml in EtOH).

substeps.instruction: Grow the cells overnight (16-18 hours) at 37 °C and 220 rpm.

steps.title: Prepare 1:10 Dilutions
steps.instruction: Make a 1:10 dilution of each overnight culture by adding 0.5 mL of culture into 4.5 mL of LB with Chloramphenicol.

steps.title: Measure Absorbance
steps.instruction: Measure the Abs 600 of the 1:10 diluted cultures and record the data in a notebook.

steps.title: Standardize Culture Density
steps.instruction: Dilute the cultures further to a target Abs 600 of 0.02 in a final volume of 12 mL LB medium with Chloramphenicol using a 50 mL falcon tube.

substeps.instruction: Ensure the falcon tube is amber or covered with foil to block light.

steps.title: Collect Initial Samples
steps.instruction: Take 500 μL samples of the diluted cultures at 0 hours into 1.5 mL eppendorf tubes prior to incubation.

substeps.instruction: Collect samples for each of the 8 devices (two colonies per device), totaling 16 eppendorf tubes.

steps.title: Incubate Cultures
steps.instruction: Incubate the remainder of the cultures at 37 °C and 220 rpm for 6 hours.

steps.title: Collect Final Samples
steps.instruction: Take 500 μL samples of the cultures at 6 hours of incubation into 1.5 mL eppendorf tubes and place them on ice.

steps.title: Prepare Plates for Measurement
steps.instruction: Prepare two plates (one for 0 hours and one for 6 hours) to read both fluorescence and absorbance.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 100 μL of each sample into each well.
For each colony, pipette 4 replicate samples into the following rows: colony #1 into rows A, B, C, and D; colony #2 into rows E, F, G, and H.
Include 8 control wells in column 9 containing 100 μL of LB with Chloramphenicol only.

steps.title: Configure Instrument and Read Plates
steps.instruction: Set the instrument settings based on previous calibration curves to ensure no measurements are off scale.

substeps.instruction: Set the instrument temperature to room temperature (approximately 20-25 °C) if variable settings are available.
